claims.claim_text: The entity shall disclose, for each sustainability-related risk and opportunity that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, metrics required by an applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 46(a) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: The entity shall disclose, for each sustainability-related risk and opportunity that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the metrics the entity uses to measure and monitor that sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 46(b)(i) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: The entity shall disclose, for each sustainability-related risk and opportunity that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the metrics the entity uses to measure and monitor its performance in relation to that sustainability-related risk or opportunity, including progress towards targets it has set and targets required by law or regulation.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 46(b)(ii) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity shall apply paragraphs 57–58 to identify applicable metrics.
claims.support_notes: Section explicitly states the paragraphs 57–58 fallback approach; aligns to IFRS S1 paragraph 47.

claims.claim_text: Metrics disclosed shall include metrics associated with particular business models, activities or other common features that characterise participation in an industry.
claims.support_notes: Directly mirrors IFRS S1 paragraph 48 requirement text.

claims.claim_text: If the entity discloses a metric taken from a source other than IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity shall identify the source and the metric taken.
claims.support_notes: Section includes a dedicated subsection requiring identification of source and metric; aligns to IFRS S1 paragraph 49.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity shall disclose how the metric is defined, including whether it is derived by adjusting a metric taken from a source other than IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards and, if so, which source and how the disclosed metric differs from the metric specified in that source.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 50(a) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity shall disclose whether the metric is an absolute measure, a measure expressed in relation to another metric, or a qualitative measure (such as a red, amber, green—or RAG—status).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 50(b) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity shall disclose whether the metric is validated by a third party and, if so, which party.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 50(c) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: If a metric has been developed by the entity, the entity shall disclose the method used to calculate the metric and the inputs to the calculation, including limitations of the method used and significant assumptions made.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 50(d) requirement text reproduced in the section.

claims.claim_text: The entity shall disclose information about the targets it has set to monitor progress towards achieving its strategic goals and any targets it is required to meet by law or regulation.
claims.support_notes: Section includes the overarching targets disclosure requirement and enumerates per-target disclosure items consistent with IFRS S1 paragraph 51.

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose the metric used to set the target and to monitor progress towards reaching the target.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(a).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose the specific quantitative or qualitative target the entity has set or is required to meet.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(b).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose the period over which the target applies.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(c).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose the base period from which progress is measured.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(d).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose any milestones and interim targets.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(e).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose performance against each target and an analysis of trends or changes in the entity’s performance.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(f).

claims.claim_text: For each target, the entity shall disclose any revisions to the target and an explanation for those revisions.
claims.support_notes: Directly listed under 'For each target' in the section; aligns to IFRS S1 51(g).

claims.claim_text: The definition and calculation of metrics, including metrics used to set targets and monitor progress towards reaching them, shall be consistent over time; if a metric is redefined or replaced, the entity shall apply paragraph B52.
claims.support_notes: Section states consistency over time and references applying paragraph B52; aligns to IFRS S1 paragraph 52.

claims.claim_text: The entity shall label and define metrics and targets using meaningful, clear and precise names and descriptions.
claims.support_notes: Directly mirrors IFRS S1 paragraph 53 requirement text.

claims.claim_text: Comparative information is required in respect of the preceding period for all amounts disclosed in the reporting period.
claims.support_notes: Section includes the comparative information statement; aligns to IFRS S1 B49 (referencing paragraph 70).

claims.claim_text: Except as specified in paragraph B51, if the entity identifies new information relating to an estimated metric amount disclosed in the preceding period and the new information provides evidence of circumstances that existed in that period, the entity shall disclose a revised comparative amount reflecting that new information.
claims.support_notes: Section reproduces the B50(a) obligation for revised comparative amounts when new evidence arises.

claims.claim_text: Except as specified in paragraph B51, in the circumstances described for estimated metric amounts, the entity shall disclose the difference between the amount disclosed in the preceding period and the revised comparative amount.
claims.support_notes: Section reproduces the B50(b) obligation to disclose the difference between original and revised comparative amounts.

claims.claim_text: Except as specified in paragraph B51, in the circumstances described for estimated metric amounts, the entity shall explain the reasons for revising the comparative amount.
claims.support_notes: Section reproduces the B50(c) obligation to explain reasons for revising comparative amounts.

claims.claim_text: If the entity redefines or replaces a metric in the reporting period, the entity shall disclose a revised comparative amount unless it is impracticable to do so.
claims.support_notes: Section includes the revised comparative amount requirement for redefined/replaced metrics; aligns to IFRS S1 B52(a).

claims.claim_text: If the entity redefines or replaces a metric in the reporting period, the entity shall explain the changes.
claims.support_notes: Section includes the obligation to explain changes; aligns to IFRS S1 B52(b).

claims.claim_text: If the entity redefines or replaces a metric in the reporting period, the entity shall explain the reasons for those changes, including why the redefined or replacement metric provides more useful information.
claims.support_notes: Section includes the obligation to explain reasons and usefulness; aligns to IFRS S1 B52(c).
